content: DataPrototype can be aggregated in different roles Note that even though the meta-classes VariableDataPrototype and ParameterDat- aPrototype already express specific use cases of the underlying data type the same DataPrototype can still be aggregated in different roles, e.g. in the SwcInternal- Behavior to express different methods how to access it.
